# claude-code deliberately ABSENT: on Arch it's the AUR `claude-code` package
# (arch-aur.txt) - an npm-global copy would shadow /usr/bin/claude in PATH and
# broke repeatedly (2.1.242+ native binary segfaults; npm install-scripts policy
# blocks postinstall). On macOS use the native installer instead:
#   curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
# bitwarden-cli pinned: 2026.7.0's WASM core crashes `bw serve` on some vault
# items (invalid type: Object, expected a string) and unlock fails
# intermittently. 2026.6.0 is the last good release. Managed via npm (not
# brew) so the pin holds.
